messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: exhaustive combinatorial enumeration of order types with linear programming bounds

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration is found among the set of order types whose mutator graph fixes the minimal-area triple to be an adjacent triple in the Delaunay triangulation; exhaustive enumeration of this restricted class via the order-type database, coupled with a linear program maximizing the lower bound on all C(13,3) triangle areas subject to realizability constraints, yields a provable optimum of exactly 1/96, attained by a symmetric lattice-perturbation with three collinear-near triples each of area 1/96."}
